note: Adapted from the species-level description of Emerson (1928), originally in English; the original title is Mirotermes (Procubitermes) wasmanni, new species, and Procubitermes is a genus today; the alate and the soldier are recorded, the worker is not; the paragraphs comparing it with M. sjostedti, M. cristifrons, M. lamanianus and others are not translated; figure numbers and localities are not translated. sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head deep reddish brown, with a pale fine dot at the insertion of each hair; oval; fontanelle slit-like, pale. Antennae 15-segmented, segment 3 slightly shorter than segment 4, segment 4 shorter than segment 2. Compound eyes medium-sized, not very prominent. Ocelli 0.12 mm long, oval, 0.05 mm from the compound eye. Postclypeus slightly paler than the head, the median line very faint. Pronotum concolorous with the postclypeus, posterior margin concave. Posterior margins of the mesonotum and metanotum concave, the angle formed nearly a right angle. Wings smoky, all the veins distinct. Body length with wings 11.50 mm; body length (without wings) 7.30–7.70 mm; head length 1.15 mm; head width 1.06 mm; antennal length 1.55 mm; compound eye diameter 0.30 mm; pronotal length 0.51 mm, width 0.89 mm; hind tibia length 0.95 mm; forewing length 9.86 mm, width 2.25 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head reddish yellow, slightly darker on the frons; head rectangular and short, the sides straight and parallel; in profile the frons is nearly vertical and forms a rather sharp angle with the vertex; the mentum with a distinct median projection. Labrum rather deeply incised, with two slightly pointed projections. Mandibles not strongly curved, each with a small basal tooth. Anterior margin of the pronotum slightly concave. Head length including the mandibles 2.60 mm; head width 1.10 mm; antennal length 2.00 mm; pronotal length 0.25 mm, width 0.55 mm; hind tibia length 0.89 mm; left mandible length 1.50 mm.
